condition: 2+ months in the last 6 with any instalment paid late (worst DPD across loans > 0)
Days past due trending upwards by 1+ day per month over the last 6 instalment months
1+ partially paid instalments in the last 6 months
Income receipts fell month on month for 2+ consecutive months, totalling at least 10% (3 months gives two-thirds strength)
Average inflows of the last 3 months 10%+ below the prior 3 months
Average balance of the last 3 months 15%+ below the prior 3 months
Outflows exceeded inflows in 2+ of the last 6 months
1+ bounced or returned transactions in the last 6 months
Revolving utilisation up 15+ percentage points over the last 6 months
1+ new facilities opened in the last 6 months (excluding the first facility of a new customer)
Obligations as a share of inflows up 5+ percentage points over the last 6 months
2+ new credit inquiries in the last 90 days
1+ GST/VAT returns filed late or not filed in the last 6 months (SMEs only)
Days to collect from customers up 10+ days over the last 6 months (SMEs only)
